hooks.name: kiro-secops-guard-shell
hooks.description: Blocks categorically dangerous commands; confirmations live in permissions.yaml.

hooks.name: kiro-secops-guard-write
hooks.description: Blocks write, append, and removal on secret files.

hooks.name: kiro-secops-review-gate
hooks.description: Security review of the changes at the end of the turn.

action.prompt: Review the changes in this session: exposed secrets, injection (SQL/command/XSS), missing/incorrect access control, weak cryptography, and vulnerable dependencies. For each finding: severity, file:line, CWE/OWASP, and fix. If nothing is found, confirm the review.

hooks.name: kiro-secops-scan-postexec
hooks.description: Advisory (non-blocking) security scan at the end of each task, via the cross-platform binary.

hooks.name: kiro-secops-sdd-requirements
hooks.description: Ensures a Security Requirements (EARS) section in the specs' requirements.md.

action.prompt: If '## Security Requirements' is missing, add it in EARS (WHEN ... THE SYSTEM SHALL ...): allowlist input validation, authN before authZ, secrets in a vault, crypto in transit/at rest, errors without leakage, logging/auditing, rate limiting, and abuse cases.

hooks.name: kiro-secops-sdd-threatmodel
hooks.description: Ensures a Threat Model (STRIDE) section in the specs' design.md.

action.prompt: If '## Security Considerations / Threat Model' is missing, add: trust boundaries, STRIDE per component, authN/authZ, validation/encoding, secrets and keys, data classification + crypto, logging/monitoring, and supply chain risks.
